outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar-style diagram showing single calculated percentage values (illumination overhead) per exposure-time condition; no averaging across replicates or error bars, so individual data points are not applicable.
Photobleaching decay curves are line plots with shaded mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
ΔROS vs exposure time is a scatter plot where each point (with error bar) is itself a data point; scatter plots are exempt.
Migration track plots already show individual cell paths (each line = one migrating cell), so individual data are directly displayed.
Bar chart of migration speed (mean±s.e.m.) has individual data points (dots for each cell) overlaid on the bars.
Panel F consists of micrograph images (MitoTracker/Paxillin/merge), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a time-series of micrographs, not a plot showing averages.
Panel H is a time-series of micrographs, not a plot showing averages.
Cell morphology over time is a line plot with mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Mitochondrial morphology over time is a line plot with mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
